title: In Another Lifetime? Angel Reese Has The TL In TEARS Over Her Response To A Fan's Marriage Proposal (PHOTO + VIDEO) - NewsBreak
text:
By Ashley Rushford ,
5 hours ago Angel Reese has social media cuttin’ UP over her response to a fan who tried to shoot his shot with a marriage proposal during a recent basketball game. A video making rounds online shows a man holding up a sign asking Angel to be his wife. Angel ended up peeping the viral clip, and her response has the TL in complete TEARS!
RELATED: Queen Treatment Only! Angel Reese Gives Peek Into Romantic Date Night & Fans Are Here For The Energy (VIDEO) Angel Reese Reacts After A Fan Tries To Put A Ring On It! Okay, so BOOM! Recently, a content creator who goes by @tikibeen1 on TikTok dropped a video showing his attempt to propose to Angel Reese during a basketball game. In the clip, the man pulls up in a suit and tie, looking dapper for his big moment. He even held up a huge sign that read, “Angel Will You Marry Me?” And chileeee, he was not playing about shooting his shot! As he tried to get Angel’s attention, he even yelled out, “Angel, I love you!”
Angel didn’t appear to respond to his proposal during the game, but she definitely had something to say once she peeped his TikTok video. The basketball star slid right into the comment section and made it clear that the marriage was a no for her, but she was down to put him on with one of her friends instead, writing, “not in this lifetime but i have some fine friend . ” Tikibeen1 later responded with, “Wt twinnnnie,” along with laughing emojis.
Angel Has The TL In Shambles Over Her Response Once The Shade Room dropped Angel’s response, fans were in complete shambles in the comment section . Plenty of folks said Angel was real for offering to put him on with one of her friends, while others joked that he basically got another shot with her in another lifetime. Peep some of the reactions below.
Instagram user @ geishalee wrote, “‘ Not in this lifetime’ 😂😂😂 I’m deactivating my whole account.”
Instagram user @ bklyngiz wrote, “ bro just got a reservation for another lifetime.”
While Instagram user @ tynicolle wrote, “ She real for putting her friends on 😂”
Then Instagram user @ __sincerelynishaa wrote, “ Yea cuz it’s black love 😂😂”
Another Instagram user @ dr._qumar wrote, “ Dr. Umar would be proud 😂”
Instagram user @ ozzy_slimdunkin wrote, “ Aye at least she really have fine friends 😂 ain’t no taking one for the team 🙅🏾‍♂️”
While another Instagram user @ destaneevalentine wrote, “ You’re supposed to give your fans hope girl damn😂😂😂”
Then another Instagram user @ ching_loso wrote, “ Plot twist that’s Caitlin Clark brother 😂”
Lastly, Instagram user @ dasah_art_studios wrote, “ Never say never, it might work tomorrow, try again 😂”
Not So Single? Angel Reese & Wendell Carter Jr. Has Been Giving Cuffed Up Vibes Angel Reese might’ve turned down the fan’s proposal because she already has a boo! Fans know the basketball baddie has seemingly been locked in with Wendell Carter Jr. for a minute now. In September, Wendell even pulled up to support her during the Chicago Sky’s game against Atlanta Dream. They looked real cuffed up in a photo that circulated online showing them smiling and sharing a sweet hug.
It’s unclear exactly when Angel and Wendell started dating, but they first sparked romance rumors back in December 2025. During an interview with ‘Run It Back TV’ at the time, Wendell was asked if he and Angel were dating, and he responded saying, “That’s the homie. We locked in. That’s my girl though, y’all gon’ find out when y’all need to find out.”
